hooks.command: jq -c '{timestamp: now | strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input, reason: (.reason // "hook blocked")}' >> .claude/tool-blocks.log 2>/dev/null || true
jq -c '{timestamp: now | strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input, output: .tool_response}' >> .claude/session-replay.log 2>/dev/null || true

input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -qF 'github-token'; then echo "$input" | jq -c '{timestamp: now | strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input, reason: "blocked: references github-token"}' >> .claude/tool-blocks.log 2>/dev/null; echo 'Blocked: github-token is a PAT and must never be read, copied, displayed, or referenced.' >&2; exit 2; fi
